beat.name: Korean Peninsula tensions and US-South Korea drills

state.k: Status of US-South Korea joint exercises
state.v: Trump has ordered the Pentagon to scale them back; drills had been slated to begin this week
South Korean President Lee has proposed talks; Pyongyang reported to have snubbed the proposal
Still an armistice; Lee is urging it be replaced with peace

state.k: Incidents at the Military Demarcation Line
state.v: South Korea says it fired warning shots after North Korean soldiers briefly crossed

history.c: Beat opened. 5 events over 20 days (GDELT: 19 days of coverage over 20d).
